entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: An elder dragon planeswalker who, sixty years earlier, came to Amonkhet, destroyed its mortals, subdued its gods and set up the Trials, and is now awaited as the God-Pharaoh; this page does not name him.

entities.name: Oketra
entities.description: A god of Amonkhet, an archer, who is defeated by the dragon along with Hazoret while protecting children.

entities.name: Hazoret
entities.description: The spear-wielding god of Amonkhet who fights the dragon, protects orphaned children, and later waits at the Gate for the God-Pharaoh.

entities.name: Kefnet
entities.description: The caretaker of the Hekma whose mind is fractured in two by the dragon.

entities.name: The Gods of Amonkhet
entities.description: The eight gods who defended Naktamun and were subdued by the dragon, leaving five to be remade.

entities.name: Djeru
entities.description: A devout initiate who runs with Samut to the Luxa River as the Hours begin and hopes the God-Pharaoh will grant them a place.

entities.name: Samut
entities.description: A dissenter who stays at Djeru's side, doubts the God-Pharaoh, and draws her khopeshes at the demon.

entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: A planeswalker whom Djeru calls the traitor for intervening in his final Trial.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A necromancer planeswalker whom the demon calls by name from the sky.

entities.name: Razaketh
entities.description: A crocodile-like demon with a mad smile who emerges from the Gate, turns the Luxa River to blood with blood magic and calls for Liliana Vess; this page does not name him.

entities.name: The Hekma
entities.description: A shimmering protective barrier over Naktamun maintained by Kefnet, which the dragon breaks through.

entities.name: Naktamun
entities.description: The city of Amonkhet, all that remained of the plane when the dragon came.

entities.name: The Luxa
entities.description: The river flowing through Naktamun to the Gate, which the demon turns to blood.

entities.name: Gate to the Afterlife
entities.description: A massive stone barrier where the Luxa meets the Hekma, which opens at the Hours to reveal endless wastes.

entities.name: The Necropolis
entities.description: A fabled building beyond the Gate where the worthy dead await the God-Pharaoh's return.

entities.name: The Hours
entities.description: The prophesied era that begins when the second sun settles between the horns.

entities.name: Amonkhet
entities.description: The desert plane Bolas remade into a place of Trials.

entities.name: The Anointed
entities.description: The enchanted dead raised by the dragon to care for the orphaned infants.

events.summary: Sixty years earlier, the dragon arrives from another world with only days of magic left to put his plan in motion.
events.quote: He had days.

events.summary: The gods of Amonkhet fight the dragon outside the Hekma, and Oketra's arrows fail to harm him.
events.quote: The arrow hit the dragon's side, and he laughed.

events.summary: The dragon fractures Kefnet's mind in two, and Kefnet falls.
events.quote: The dragon tipped his chin and fractured Kefnet's mind in two.

events.summary: With Kefnet down, the Hekma wavers and the dragon bursts through it.
events.quote: the hole widened enough for the dragon to burst through.

events.summary: The dragon, protected by shifting half a step from reality, lands on the tallest tower and channels a spell.
events.quote: The dragon landed atop the tallest tower, closed his eyes, and began to channel a spell.

events.summary: The dragon dissipates every mortal old enough to walk, leaving only infants and the gods in shock.
events.quote: every mortal old enough to walk dissipated into the sky.

events.summary: Hazoret and Oketra flee to a mausoleum and gather the orphaned children as the dragon follows.
events.quote: Hazoret began gently picking up as many children as she could.

events.summary: The dragon breaks the seal and blanks the minds of Hazoret and Oketra, who fall defeated.
events.quote: the minds of the two gods went utterly blank.

events.summary: The dragon takes three gods for himself and corrupts the leylines of the remaining gods to bind them to him and to forget their origins.
events.quote: he returned to the surface and took three of the gods for his own.

events.summary: The dragon raises the enchanted dead as caretakers and repurposes an elite sacrificial ceremony into the endless Trials, setting the second sun to move on his schedule.
events.quote: He spelled the second sun to move as he was ready

events.summary: The dragon builds a throne and a horned monument, and plants a promise of his return in the gods and the people.
events.quote: he made a promise to return

events.summary: Decades later, the second sun settles between the horns and the dragon comes to collect his hoard.
events.quote: The time had come for the dragon to return to collect his hoard.

events.summary: Djeru and Samut run to the Luxa as the Hours begin amid a stampede of citizens, and Hazoret strides to the river.
events.quote: all racing toward the banks of the Luxa River.

events.summary: Samut asks Djeru to promise to protect their gods and each other.
events.quote: No matter what happens, we protect our gods. We protect each other.

events.summary: The second sun reaches its final point and the Gate cracks open, then swings wide to reveal endless wastes instead of paradise.
events.quote: What lay beyond the Gate were endless, empty wastes.

events.summary: Samut asks Hazoret if that is paradise, and the god does not answer.
events.quote: Is that paradise?

events.summary: A winged demon flies through the Gate and perches on an obelisk, and Samut recognizes it.
events.quote: Demons were rare on Amonkhet.

events.summary: The demon spills its own blood into the Luxa, turning the river to blood and killing the creatures in it.
events.quote: The demon had turned the river into blood.

events.summary: Samut asks Djeru whether he still believes the God-Pharaoh is benevolent, and Djeru's doubt grows.
events.quote: Do you still believe this is the act of a benevolent God-Pharaoh?

events.summary: The demon calls out for Liliana Vess, saying she cannot hide.
events.quote: I know you are here, Liliana Vess. You cannot hide from me.

relations.quote: tying their existence to himself, and forcing them to erase all else.

relations.note: fractured his mind and body in two, causing him to fall
relations.quote: The dragon tipped his chin and fractured Kefnet's mind in two.

relations.note: fight and flee together as sisters
relations.quote: Hazoret pulled Oketra up from the ground with a quiet assertion.

relations.note: one of the gods, caretaker of the Hekma
she stays at his side in protection
relations.quote: Yet Samut now stood at his side, a hand gripping Djeru's arm

relations.note: the demon calls her out by name
relations.quote: I know you are here, Liliana Vess.
